utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive — what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. First we need to sort the donations and see what’s actually missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll sort the donations and make a missing-items list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I want to make sure the timing and pickup details are clear before we commit.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right—can you confirm the pickup time and who’s handling it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s lock down the pickup time first, then I can tell you who’s handling it. I just want to avoid any mix-up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I’m listening; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Noah. I just need you to help me sort the donations and maybe keep an eye on the tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can do that—I'll sort the donations and keep an eye on the tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with the others and repeat the repair drive plan so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — that’d help a lot. I’m out running errands, so I’ll spread the word if I hear anything too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Ira — I’ll circle back once I’ve talked to everyone. Let’s keep the repair drive plan clear for the whole block.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries at all — could you help sort the donated tools and hand them out as folks arrive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and hand them out as people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs fixing, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — let’s start with the biggest fixes first, then sort out the smaller stuff right after. I’ll put together a quick list and share a start time with everyone today.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me—please send the list and start time today, and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam, what time is the repair drive starting, and do you still need extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It starts at 10 a.m., and yes, extra hands would be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll be there at 10. What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d love to help get the repair drive going—what’s the best way I can pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: If you can, head over to the community center and check in at the front desk—they’re organizing drop-offs there. I’m keeping track of locations, so I can point you to the right spot if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll head to the community center and check in at the front desk. If anything changes, just point me to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive, Rosa—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Mara. Could you help me make a quick list of needed supplies and then check in with a few neighbors about donations?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll make a quick supplies list and check in with a few neighbors about donations.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supplies list in order, Bo—just tell me what the repair drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just give me the short version of what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need screws, duct tape, and one replacement hinge. If you want, I can check what’s already been donated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together pretty well—folks are dropping off tools and donations already.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. I should stop by and see if they need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, you should swing by—I'm sure they’d welcome another set of hands. I’ll let you know if I hear they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Hana—could you first check the repair list and the pickup times? I want to make sure they line up with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely—I’ll check the repair list and the pickup times against the school schedule, then report back if anything looks off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just a quick heads-up on the repairs, and I’ll swing back with the details after I finish my errands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No rush — just send me the repair details when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Vik — thank you. I’ll put together a simple list of tasks so people know where to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — send me the list when it’s ready, and I’ll pass it around to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit behind; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s still going, just a little more urgent now. I can fill you in on the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please do—I must’ve missed the latest. What’s the urgent part?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still figuring out the repair drive, Gus—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill and a few spare screws if you need them. If you want, I can swing by and help sort the pile too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, Gus—if you can swing by, I’d really appreciate the help sorting it out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m putting the repair drive notes in order now, Opal—what do you want to make sure we cover first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with where each repair is happening, so we can keep the notes grouped by location.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great—I'll group them by address and keep each spot together. If you have the first location handy, I’ll start there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where the drop-off will be before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the timing and drop-off spot as soon as I have it. I’ll make sure you’re looped in right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — please do, and I’ll hold off until I have those details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is actually happening, right? I just want to make sure before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s happening — but let me double-check the details before you pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll hold off until you confirm. Just let me know when the details are set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple, then: we should make a clear list of what needs fixing and who’s handling each part. I’m happy to help if you want me to stick to a routine.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I usually show up a bit late, so a clear list would help me jump in fast. Put me down for whatever’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I’ll mark you for the open items and keep the list easy to follow. I’ll bring the latest notes so we can get started without any fuss.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still catching up on the repair drive — what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re in pretty good shape so far, but I’m still keeping an eye on what’s running low. If you want, I can check the supply list and see what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m still piecing it together, so a quick update would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help, but I’ll need the details again if you’ve already shared them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I’ll send you the repair drive details again, and thank you for helping.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out for the details and do my part once they come through.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around school drop-off and pick-up times for the repair drive. Just tell me what window you need, and I’ll fit it in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — could you do 9:30 to 11:30? That window should work best for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, 9:30 to 11:30 works for me — I’ll plan around school drop-off and pick-up.
